settings.identity: agent must be this host's agent peer name, not its actor peer name. Replace web01 in settings and both allow targets together.
settings.recommendation: Use block-port/unblock-port only. nftables expires every block even if no revert order arrives.
settings.services: stop-service/start-service need root or an explicit polkit rule and are not covered by nn-actor-host.service. To enable them, list exact service units in services and allow both actions locally.
settings.max_ttl: A duration of at least 1s; fractional seconds are rounded down. TTL 0 uses max_ttl.
